stem.text: A cell of electromotive force (e.m.f.) $E$ and internal resistance $r$ is connected to a variable resistor, as shown.

stem.alt: Circuit diagram of a cell labelled E and a resistor labelled r inside a dashed box, connected in a loop with a variable resistor. Voltage arrows are labelled v across the dashed box and V across the variable resistor.

stem.text: The resistance of the variable resistor is gradually increased from $r$ to $3r$.
Which graph shows the variation of the potential difference (p.d.) $v$ across the internal resistance with the p.d. $V$ across the variable resistor?

A.alt: Graph with v on the vertical axis and V on the horizontal axis, marked 0, 0.5E and 1.0E, showing a short downward-sloping line segment.

B.alt: Graph with v on the vertical axis and V on the horizontal axis, marked 0, 0.5E and 1.0E, showing a short upward-sloping line segment.

C.alt: Graph with v on the vertical axis and V on the horizontal axis, marked 0, 0.5E and 1.0E, showing a short downward-sloping line segment.

D.alt: Graph with v on the vertical axis and V on the horizontal axis, marked 0, 0.5E and 1.0E, showing an upward-sloping line segment from 0.5E to 1.0E.
